name: Covenant Slipspace Drive Schematics
desc: Schematics of a Covenant slipspace drive, compiled by Huragok engineers, holding the routines that tear open a slipspace rupture. Integrated with a fleet, they let ships fitted with a Slipspace Drive open their own slipspace ruptures.

name: Covenant Slipspace Navigation System
desc: A Covenant navigation suite that resolves slipspace exits down to exact coordinates. Integrated with a fleet's slipspace drives, it lets the fleet emerge at a chosen point in any star system it has visited, or jump from one point of its current system to another.
